title: Delivery Attestation
description: Phase 8 attestation block — required in any committable deliverable that declares closure (CLOSED/PASS/DONE/SHIPPED/COMPLETE/FINALIZED/READY) in declarative context. The Wave 2 PreToolUse hook (plugin/scripts/pre-delivery-discipline.js) and the Wave 3 CI validator (tests/validate-delivery-honesty.test.mjs) both enforce this shape. Implementation lives in hasValidAttestation() in pre-delivery-discipline.js; this schema file is the authoritative documentation of the contract.

covered.description: Concrete items verified in this deliverable. Enumeration, not summary.

scope_cuts.description: Items explicitly left OUT of this deliverable, each with a reason. Empty array allowed but suspicious — forces the agent to look hard.

self_review_findings.description: Adversarial findings from Rule 4 self-review. At least 3 items, each substantive (>=20 characters). 'No findings' is itself evidence of insufficient review.

external_review_status.description: External (R2/R3) review state for this deliverable. 'pending' = not yet reviewed; 'cleared' = review passed; 'blocked' = review found P0/P1 and the deliverable is not shippable until fixed. Full audit-log cross-reference of this field against real review-record entries is Phase 8.1 scope.
